IX. COMMENTS AND COORDINATION
A. Early Coordination Meetings
In order to provide the opportunity for Regional and County planning bodies, local and municipal jurisdictions, residents and businesses to become involved in the Lincoln Highway (U.S. Route 30) improvement, and to express their ideas; a series of eleven (11) meetings were held between September 2, 1970 and December 16,1974. A listing of these early coordination meetings is shown in Exhibit "29", page IX-2.
In addition, to document early coordination in relation to the Cook County Forest Preserve District and the Roosevelt School property, opinions were requested relative to possible Lincoln Highway/Section 4(f) land involvement from the Cook County Forest Preserve District, the United States Department of Agriculture, the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development, the United States Department of the Interior, and the Board of Education, District 170, Cook County, Illinois. An evaluation and disposition of comments received through this early coordination process is shown on page IX-3 through IX-6. Copies of the letters received are contained in Appendix G.
